script:
Pan Deputy Director
I am the deputy director of Health Hospital. Actually, I'm not just a deputy director - that's only my surface identity. My real identity is the link between organ trafficking organizations and the hospital. Whenever someone needs organs but regular sources are insufficient, I sell them organs from the organization for huge profits.
In September 2017, Dr. Zhen's mother was hospitalized due to heart disease. Somehow Dr. Zhen obtained a recording of my secret transactions with patients' families and used it to blackmail me into giving his mother a heart transplant.
I had no choice. After matching, there was only one heart in the organ bank that successfully matched his mother. But I had already sold this heart to Bai Patient's family for 500,000 yuan in advance. I could only tell him that if he was willing to pay a higher price, I would agree. Unexpectedly, he really came up with 800,000 yuan, so I had to agree to give his mother the heart originally meant for Bai Patient. Unexpectedly, after the surgery, he not only didn't hand over the recording but continued to threaten me with it. I thought I must also get something on him.
In mid-January, the hospital suddenly discovered a large discrepancy in cardiac surgery equipment expenses. Ke Accountant was the prime suspect, but I found it suspicious. I secretly checked the account books and indeed found that the person who embezzled the equipment expenses was Director Zhen. I planned to use this leverage to fight back hard against him.
On January 24th, Dr. Jia, who was newly transferred to the hospital, died suddenly. I always felt there was something strange about this. Dr. Jia was actually coming to be the head of cardiac surgery, but she died just like that. The direct beneficiary of her death was Dr. Zhen. Only he would fear that Dr. Jia, as the new director, would discover his loopholes. Without Dr. Jia, he had the highest seniority, and the cardiac surgery director position would definitely be his. All his dirty deeds could remain undiscovered forever. I personally conducted a very careful examination of Dr. Jia and indeed found that while it appeared to be heart failure on the surface, she was actually poisoned with chronic poison. I kept a real cause-of-death report to threaten Director Zhen. I hadn't planned to tell anyone about this, but Nurse Wang found out. She's my lover, and I was so happy the day I discovered the cause of death - I finally had leverage on Director Zhen - so I had her drink with me and let it slip. I made her promise to keep it secret, and she agreed.
On January 26th, I discovered that all my organ transaction contracts were missing. It must have been Director Zhen who took them. I called Director Zhen to question him, but he wouldn't admit it. I told him about his poisoning of Dr. Jia and the financial loopholes I discovered, telling him not to threaten me anymore. But he actually said if we were going down, we'd go down together. He's a madman! I can't go down with him, so he must die. If he doesn't die, I'll never have peace.
[February 3rd - Night of the Incident]
18:00 - Nurse Wang and I finished the last surgery together.
21:00 - I returned to the hospital. To avoid being seen by others, I entered through the back door and took the abandoned west staircase to the second-floor office.
21:10 - I walked to Director Zhen's office door and heard Ke Accountant and Director Zhen talking inside. I didn't dare stay too long, so I hid in an abandoned storage room at the end of the second-floor corridor, planning to wait until Ke Accountant left before going in to kill Director Zhen with a scalpel I had prepared.
21:10-21:50 - During this time, there were intermittent footsteps in the corridor, so I never came out.
21:55 - I left the storage room and found the second floor had lost power. I groped my way in the dark into Director Zhen's office, but he was lying on the desk as if sleeping. When I got closer, I found a knife wound on his chest, some blood drops on the floor, and a bloody scalpel. Director Zhen was already dead. Thinking that I also brought a scalpel of the same model, I didn't dare stay long and panicked, leaving via the west abandoned staircase.
22:05 - I went to a mall near the hospital to browse around.
22:25 - I prepared to pay and go home. When paying, I realized my wallet was missing. My heart sank - could it have been left in Director Zhen's office? Then I really couldn't explain myself.
22:40 - I returned to the second floor of the hospital. The second floor was still pitch black. I saw Director Zhen lying at my office door, his chest hollow with his heart removed, and a large pool of blood. I felt someone must be trying to frame me. I had to drag him away from my office.
I dragged him to the morgue at the end of the second-floor corridor. I found the morgue key from my key chain containing all second-floor keys, opened the door, and threw him inside. Then I took a mop from the storage room and cleaned up all the blood traces along the way. After washing the mop clean, I hid it back in the storage room. When leaving, I found my dropped wallet in the storage room and took it back.
22:55 - I quickly left the hospital again via the abandoned west staircase.
acts_goal: Find the real culprit of this case, try to hide the fact that you went to the scene the first time.
